comparison.objective: Reorient an angle-grinder guard toward an operator and clamp it; the candidate calibrates and locks a robot-gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: The board task opens an over-centre lever, rotates a guard, and reclamps it while avoiding the disc; the candidate seats two concentric tools and counterholds screw torque during jam-nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: The guard must face the operator within 30°, have its lever flat, and leave the grinder nearly unmoved; the candidate must retain a 90° stop through three cycles with bounded drift and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: Both preserve an angular setting after locking, but the guard task tests lever-mediated safety-guard positioning rather than coupled threaded adjustment and countertorque.
